h1: Custom Large Workwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom large workwear for your team at Perfect Imprints. High-vis jackets, vests, and more in bulk. Get your quote today!
introHtml: When your crew needs durable, well-fitting workwear, sizing matters. Large is one of the most requested sizes for safety vests, hi-vis jackets, and work shirts. Whether you're equipping a construction team with custom Carhartt® Duck Vests or ordering embroidered Signal Hi-Vis Jackets for a highway crew, large sizes ensure comfort and mobility on the job. We offer screen printing and embroidery on a range of large workwear options built for real work conditions.
heroAltText: Custom large workwear including hi-vis vest and jacket with company logo for construction team
